title: Authority Carries Over
description: Rotating a session shouldn't be a chance for a crew member to quietly get promoted. Confirm a refreshed token still reflects the same rank the database has on file.
successCondition: Log in as admin@swiftcargo.test and confirm GET /api/auth/admin-check returns 200 with the initial access token. Call POST /api/auth/refresh to rotate the session, then call GET /api/auth/admin-check again with the NEW access token — it still returns 200. Querying the users table via `npm run db:psql` for that account's role confirms it is still "admin" throughout (rotation never touches the users table, only refresh_tokens).
hints: signAccessToken (apps/api/src/core/jwt.ts) reads the role from the User row passed into issueSession — refresh() looks that row up fresh via the stored refresh token's relation, so a stale claim isn't possible by construction, but verify it rather than assume it.
Demo accounts and their shared password are documented in docs/self-host.md.
